scope: Read-only source verification; no model calls or pilot edits

source_identity.note: Retrieved aps/super_glue rows API; observed dataset repository revision from live Hugging Face metadata. Rows API is not itself revision-pinned; normalized downloaded row hashes are authoritative for reproduction.

fields.source_text_omitted: RTE source text omitted from public export; retrieve the original row from the linked source.

rte.yes_mapping: For the question whether the premise entails the hypothesis, target_yes = 1 - label.
rte.definition: Decide whether the premise entails the hypothesis. Non-entailment includes unsupported hypotheses as well as contradictions.
rte.provenance: SuperGLUE reuses GLUE RTE; merges RTE1, RTE2, RTE3, RTE5 and converts to two classes.
rte.license: No unified permissive license verified. HF card marks other and refers to original dataset licenses, with a research-context use/redistribution statement. Exact upstream RTE terms remain unverified.

wic.yes_mapping: For the question whether the marked word has the same meaning in both sentences, target_yes = label.
wic.definition: Binary classification of whether two occurrences of a target noun or verb share the same sense.
wic.provenance: Pilehvar and Camacho-Collados (2019); examples drawn from WordNet, VerbNet and Wiktionary.
wic.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 explicitly stated by dataset authors. Do not relabel as CC BY 4.0 or Apache/MIT.
wic.offset_caveat: Field types verified; character offset end-exclusive convention was not independently verified in this short pass. Check sentence[start:end] against intended word occurrences before rendering markers.

benchmark_caveats: These are old public evaluation sets; label agreement does not establish unseen-data generalization or absence of training contamination.
Keep the published labels and exact source row IDs frozen; any label audit exclusions must be separately reported.
Report RTE and WiC results separately; neither is an exact event-probability ground truth task.
